name: Emperor Kōkō
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 15); Porter’s note gives the dates as: reigned 885–887.

poems.title: Mother, for thy sake I have been
poems.author: Emperor Kōkō
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 15
poems.text:
Mother, for thy sake I have been
Where the wakana grow,
To bring thee back some fresh green leaves;
And see—my koromo
Is sprinkled with the snow!
